teaser: This issue's 37 papers cluster around nurses' readiness for AI and clinical decision support testing. Several studies measure nursing students' and clinicians' AI literacy, anxiety, and attitudes, often finding mixed knowledge but generally positive views. A parallel set of papers tests prediction tools for triage, delirium, pressure injuries, and stroke mortality using nursing and bedside data, usually comparing machine learning against simpler scores. A third thread raises governance and ethics questions, covering intersectionality in AI design, ethics scales, professional organization roles, and frameworks for system-level oversight.

themes.name: Nurses' attitudes, anxiety, and readiness for AI
Testing clinical prediction and decision support tools
